methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified dataset of nine electric shaver models from Braun, Philips Norelco, and Panasonic. Each product re-checked against manufacturer pages (us.braun.com, usa.philips.com, shop.panasonic.com), major retailers (Amazon, Target, Best Buy, Walmart), and specialist reviews (ShaverCheck). priceUsd reflects US MSRP or the most-commonly-listed current retail price in USD as of accessedAt; where no single published US price could be corroborated for the exact SKU, priceUsd is set to null and explained in priceNote/provenance. Boolean specs (wet_dry, quick_charge implied by quick_charge_min, cleaning_station) are true only when the feature ships on the named SKU. battery_min is manufacturer-claimed cordless runtime in minutes. A null beats a guess: unverifiable display/spec values were nulled rather than guessed. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Braun Series 9 Pro+ 9667cc
products.priceNote: Most-commonly-listed US retail price for this SKU; MSRP not separately published

specs.shaving_elements: 5+1 (5 shaving elements incl. 2 Ultra Thin Gliding Foils, SkinGuard, Direct&Cut, Lift&Cut + Precision ProTrimmer)

products.provenance: Braun US product page confirms 5+1 shaving elements (2 Ultra Thin Gliding Foils, SkinGuard, Direct&Cut, Lift&Cut, plus Precision ProTrimmer), up to 60-min Li-Ion runtime, 6-in-1 SmartCare Center, 100% waterproof wet/dry. Ships with PowerCase + textile travel case. ShaverCheck 96XX review confirms 5-min quick charge and Performance Assistant LED display. Price $319.94 corroborated via e-catalog US aggregation and search results. 2025 launch (UK June 2025, then USA). Draft's '4 active foil elements' phrasing corrected to Braun's actual 5-element description.

products.name: Braun Series 9 Pro+ 9677cc (PowerCase)
products.priceNote: No single published US retail price corroborated for this exact SKU; differs from 9667cc by including PowerCase instead of the standard textile travel case

specs.shaving_elements: 5+1 (5 shaving elements incl. 2 Ultra Thin Gliding Foils, SkinGuard, Direct&Cut, Lift&Cut + Precision ProTrimmer)

products.provenance: Braun US page (live) confirms model 9677cc: 5+1 synchronized shaving elements, up to 60-min Li-Ion battery, 6-in-1 SmartCare Center, 100% waterproof, Performance Assistant display. ShaverCheck/PickShavers confirm the differentiator from the 9667cc is the included PowerCase (portable +50% charging case) in place of the standard textile travel case. Draft's $319.94 was an unverified carry-over from the 9667cc; no published US price for the 9677cc SKU could be corroborated, so priceUsd set to null.

products.name: Braun Series 9 Pro+ 9567cc

specs.shaving_elements: 5+1 (5 ProShave elements incl. ProLift Blade + Precision ProTrimmer)

products.provenance: Amazon listing and ShaverCheck 95XX review confirm USA release 12 Oct 2023, 5 ProShave elements + Precision ProTrimmer, 60-min Li-Ion battery, 5-min quick charge, 6-in-1 SmartCare Center. MSRP $379.99 (Best Buy); current street price ~$299.99 corroborated across retailers.

products.name: Braun Series 8 8567cc
products.provenance: Braun US, Amazon and Target listings confirm 8567cc has 4+1 Technology = 4 sonic-powered shaving elements + Precision ProTrimmer (draft incorrectly said '3 active sonic foil elements'; corrected to 4), 60-min battery, 5-in-1 SmartCare Center (clean/lubricate/dry/charge = cleaning station), 100% waterproof. Target confirms current price $229.99.

products.name: Braun Series 7 7185cc

specs.shaving_elements: 3 (2 foil elements + 1 slit/precision trimmer between foils)

products.provenance: Braun US page and Amazon confirm 7185cc: 360 Flex head, 2 foils + central trimmer, 100% waterproof, 5-min quick charge, 4-in-1 SmartCare Center, up to 60-min runtime, Turbo/Standard/Gentle modes, 2024 release. Price $189.99 confirmed via Dealmoon/Amazon.

products.name: Braun Series 5 5118s
products.priceNote: Target current price; no cleaning station (charging via cable/stand only)
products.provenance: Target and Amazon listings confirm 5118s: 3 flex blades (2 foil + precision trimmer), 50-min Li-Ion runtime, wet/dry waterproof, Turbo + Standard modes, 2024 Turbo update. ShaverCheck confirms no Braun Series 5 model ships with an automated cleaning station — charging stand/cable only. Quick charge not advertised on this SKU (nulled). Price $79.99 at Target.

products.name: Philips Norelco S9000 Prestige SP9886/89

specs.shaving_elements: 3 rotary heads with dual-row Lift & Cut blades (Space Grade Steel)

products.provenance: Philips USA page confirms SP9886/89: rotary Lift & Cut system with Space Grade Steel blades, 60-min battery, Qi wireless charging pad only (no wired cable), Quick Clean Pod included, digital display. ShaverCheck independently confirms the ~18-minute fast charge for one shave (Qi only) and backlit LCD (not OLED) display, 3 heads, 2023 release. Price observed ~$299–$380; $299.99 used as representative current price.

products.name: Philips Norelco Shaver 9500 S9985/84

specs.shaving_elements: 3 rotary heads with Dual SteelPrecision Lift & Cut blades

products.provenance: Philips USA page confirms S9985/84: rotary Dual SteelPrecision Lift & Cut, 60-min battery, 5-min quick charge, Quick Clean Pod, OLED display (Philips' first), SenseIQ. Abt and product manuals confirm release September 2021 (draft had null; corrected to 2021). Price $239.99 (MSRP/Target).

products.name: Philips Norelco OneBlade 360 QP2834/70
products.priceNote: MSRP; hybrid trimmer/shaver, not a traditional foil or rotary shaver
products.provenance: Philips USA page confirms QP2834/70: 60-min runtime from 4-hour charge, USB-A charging, fully waterproof, dual blade (1 face 360 blade + 1 body blade), 5-in-1 stubble comb. Hybrid reciprocating cutter (not foil/rotary). MSRP $49.99 corroborated; observed $49.96–$69.16 by retailer. Release 2023.

products.name: Panasonic Arc5 ES-LV97-K
products.priceNote: MSRP; observed current retail ~$190–$260 by retailer/bundle. ES-LV67-K (no station) ~$150

specs.shaving_elements: 5 (2 finishing foils, 2 lift foils, 1 center quick-slit blade)

products.provenance: Amazon ES-LV97-K listing confirms ARC5 5-blade foil system, 14,000 CPM linear motor (70,000 cross-cuts/min), 16D multi-flex head, wet/dry, pop-up trimmer, and Premium Automatic Cleaning & Charging Station (ES-LV97-K includes the station; ES-LV67-K does not). ShaverCheck confirms 45-min battery, 3-min quick charge, LCD display, 2019 release. Source URL corrected from the ES-LV67 product page (which omits the station) to the ES-LV97-K listing. Price anchored to MSRP $229.99 (draft's $239.99 was a single Walmart bundle within the $190–$260 observed range).

products.name: Panasonic Arc6 ES-LS9A-K

specs.shaving_elements: 6 (2 finishing foils, 2 lift foils, 2 thick-stubble titanium-coated blades)

products.provenance: Panasonic official shop confirms ES-LS9A-K at $424.99 (sale from $499.99), 6 hypoallergenic stainless steel blades (2 finish, 2 lift, 2 titanium-coated thick-stubble), 84,000 cross-cutting actions/min, 50-min battery, 3-min quick charge, wet/dry, premium automatic clean-and-charge station. ShaverCheck confirms 22-direction head and ~2022 launch. Display: Panasonic US shop page does not list a screen for the US SKU, so the draft's unconfirmed LED claim was nulled (a null beats a guess).
